desc:
🌊 Sunlight only reaches so far. What’s waiting for you beneath it?

Pilot your submarine from colorful reefs into darker, stranger waters. Get faster, grow stronger, and push further toward the abyss… if you dare.

⚡ Earn Speed at outposts and level up to move faster!
🚀 Evolve your submarine into powerful new forms every 5 levels!
🪸 Discover glowing caves, forgotten valleys, and dangerous sea monsters!
💥 Fire torpedoes and collect Research Data to unlock abilities!
🛟 Reach the next outpost for safety and a free upgrade point!

🎮 HOW TO PLAY
• Spawn your submarine, hop in, and follow the outpost marker.
• Step OUT of your submarine at outposts to earn Speed.
• Spend upgrade points to improve your Speed gains, hull, and torpedoes.
• Level up, explore deeper, and see how far you can get!

⭐ LIKE and FAVORITE the game to find your way back for your next dive!
